categories.name: Normal 3 Stocks All Characters
categories.rules:
Timing starts when pressing start on character select screen
Timing ends when you deliver the final blow to master hand with the last character.
You must watch the credits after Master Hand. You cannot reset the console to skip the credits.

categories.name: Very Hard 1 Stock All Characters
categories.rules:
Timing starts when pressing start on character select screen
Timing ends when you deliver the final blow to master hand with the last character.
You must watch the credits after Master Hand. You cannot reset the console to skip the credits.

categories.name: Unlock All Characters
categories.rules:
YOU MUST DELETE SOME DATA BEFORE STARTING:
- Newcomers
- Bonus Stage Scores

Timing starts on console reset
Timing ends when you unlock the final character (character unlock message appears)
Runs in the top 3 require a video and runs faster than 30 minutes also require a video.

categories.name: All Break the Targets
categories.rules:
Timing starts when pressing start on character select screen. Timing end when you break the last target of the last character. Order is up to the runner. Submit real time only.



Runs faster than 5 minutes requires a video proof.

categories.name: Very Easy 5 Stock
categories.rules:
Timing starts when pressing start on character select screen
Timing ends when you deliver the final blow to master hand
Beat Classic Mode as fast as possible
Runs in the top 3 require a video and runs faster than 7 minutes also require a video.

categories.name: Normal 3 Stock
categories.rules:
Timing starts when pressing start on character select screen
Timing ends when you deliver the final blow to master hand
Beat Classic Mode as fast as possible
Runs in the top 3 require a video and runs faster than 8 minutes also require a video.

categories.name: Very Hard 1 Stock
categories.rules:
Timing starts when pressing start on character select screen
Timing ends when you deliver the final blow to master hand
Beat Classic Mode as fast as possible
Runs in the top 3 require a video and runs faster than 9 minutes also require a video.

categories.name: Break the Targets
categories.rules:
For single character :
Beat the break the targets stage (Bonus 1) as fast as possible.
Time submitted must be the in-game time achieved.
Usage of pause is strictly forbidden during the run due to the pause glitch.
(Every pause allows 2 frames of movement without the counter updating)
Preferable to show the time on the character selection screen but not required.

Runs in the top 5 require a video and runs faster than 20 seconds also require a video.

categories.name: Board the Platforms
categories.rules:
For single character :
Beat the board the platforms stage (Bonus 2) as fast as possible.
Time submitted must be the in-game time achieved.
Usage of pause is strictly forbidden during the run due to the pause glitch.
(Every pause allows 2 frames of movement without the counter updating)
Preferable to show the time on the character selection screen but not required.

Runs in the top 5 require a video and runs faster than 40 seconds also require a video.

categories.name: All Board the Platforms
categories.rules:
Timing starts when pressing start on character select screen. Timing end when you board the last platform of the last character. Order is up to the runner. Submit real time only.



Runs faster than 7 minutes requires a video proof.

categories.name: All Bonuses
categories.rules:
Timing starts when pressing start on character select screen
Timing ends when you either break the last target or board the last platform
Use all 12 Characters in both Target Test and Board the Platforms
No particular order is needed
Runs in the top 3 require a video and runs faster than 12 minutes also require a video.

categories.name: Very Easy 5 Stocks All Characters
categories.rules:

Timing ends when you deliver the final blow to master hand with the last character.
You must watch the credits after Master Hand. You cannot reset the console to skip the credits.

runList.comment: the luigi polygon :(
Next up: Mario

chris pratt did not bless this run to have a good master hand. but still a nice run throughout. Sub 6 was theoretically possible here, but just didn't quite have the exact luck I needed in some places
PB. Went frame by frame to get exact time. I did this two years ago but never uploaded it.
GG

One night and one more time

Thanks for the memories

Even though they weren't so great

"He tastes like you only sweeter"

(think this is 42:03.210 (end) - 36:09.320 (start) = 5:53.890)

If Master Hand didn't gun on the LAST hit, this would've been sub 6 lol. But still a really sick run and getting this time already moved my goal from simply sub 6, to now getting sub 5:55!
https://www.twitch.tv/videos/2112954884https://www.twitch.tv/videos/2112954884
The Metal Mario haunts me

Caught your deviant heart

Bring in another heaven

I was just a clot

A thick syrup of evidence

(19:01.410 end - 12:14.280 start = 6:47.130)
ahp's samus strat is so goated

gottem on the derust lmao

mod notes: re-timed to 6:17.334 - remember to include USA region when submitting runs.

God tier polygon fight

Mod note: Re-timed to 6:24.060 GG

thumbnail made by PKayJay
hoping for first ever sub 5:30
finally got the sub 6

not really sure how i clutched this, but hey, I'll take it!

getting sub 6 isn't that bad, but RNG is sooooooo important.
Close to perfection, but more importantly, almost True WR.

procrastinated till the last day of July. surprised I PBd tbh but I guess I've gotten a lot better at the game in general since I last ran Ness. Sub 6:30 giga free



Mod Note: Re-timed to 6:31.37

offline run op

froze the 64 on final split again lol
Bad MH spoiled a really solid run overall
pretty okay

Gimme them points

re-timed to 5:51.57. final hit occurred 1 frame after .55 first showed on timer. nonetheless, GGs
"I see em’ up ahead. Let's rock and roll!"

You were a hurricane, I was stagnant holding on but it gets tiring

It gets so tiring

When new wave comes to wash these shores away I won't be there

fine ul ee

just missed the 4x because of a 1% lol, but still pretty good

Pound my knuckles hard against the floor

My head against the wall

But I did this to myself
the worst i played all CAM, but on the one run that was okay-ish enough to pursue, we got the GOD RNG on Master Hand. If it weren't for how much I grinded for this, I would say it's undeserved.

Feels good to be back :) hopefully I can actually not lose time on bonus stages lol

re-timed to 6:11.100
RNG Metal Mario LOL
